resources.string: Turn on Flash on the other device
Could not start Flash. Open this screen and try again.
Could not start Flash. Check the network and try again.
Flash is on. Choose a device or wait for a file.
Add the files you want to share
Address requested. Wait for the device to appear or check its connection.
Android stopped Flash. You can turn it on again whenever you need it.
Delivery %1$d of %2$d confirmed. Preparing the next file.
Compare the code and accept once on each device for the entire batch.
Status and requests for the Flash session you turn on.
Check the other device’s address and try again.
Check that both devices are on the same Wi-Fi and tap “Search again”.
Choose an available device and at least one file again.
Choose one or more files from your phone.
Compare these four groups on both devices. They must match exactly.
Compare the verification on both devices.
Could not save the copy. The original is still in Qetara.
Copy saved to your chosen location.
Delivery confirmed by the other device.
The other device confirmed that the file was received and verified.
Devices with Flash active on your Wi-Fi appear here when you start the session.
Search requested. Turn on Flash on the other device if it does not appear.
The confirmation expired. Request the transfer again from the sending device and compare the new code on both devices.
The other device does not support one confirmation per batch. Update Qetara on both devices.
The other device is already handling a transfer. Wait and try again.
Transfer cancelled. You can try again whenever you like.
Could not search that address. Check the IP, the network and that Flash is active on the other device.
The request or session expired. Turn on Flash and try again.
Could not complete the transfer. Check Flash and the other device’s connection.
The other device’s response is not compatible with Flash. Check the address and the Qetara versions on both devices.
The file failed verification. Send it again.
The address is invalid. Enter the local IP shown in Flash on the other device.
The batch exceeds the 128-file limit or the allowed size for file names and data. Reduce the selection.
This file cannot be sent. Check that it is available and there is enough space.
The other device’s Flash session no longer matches the one you selected. Search for it again and select it again.
The request was rejected or the verification did not match. The file was not sent.
Could not prepare the folder to receive the file. Check that this device’s storage is available and has enough space.
Could not confirm delivery. Check whether the file arrived on the other device before sending it again.
Could not prepare the file. Check that it is available and there is enough space, or choose another.
File prepared. Choose the receiving device and send the request.
Send and receive files with another device on the same Wi-Fi.
Turn on Flash on both devices
Compare the code and accept the batch on both devices
In Flash on the other device, open “My address”. Keep Flash active there.
No app is available to open this file. You can save a copy.
Temporarily available. Open Flash or turn it off.
Transfer in progress. Open Flash to see the progress.
Compare the verification and decide whether to transfer.
You can keep using Flash here. To see requests after leaving, allow notifications in Android Settings.
Without notifications, return to this screen to check requests.
Preparing to send. Compare the verification on both devices.
Received in Qetara. You can save a copy wherever you prefer.
Received in Qetara. You can save a copy wherever you prefer. Could not confirm delivery to the other device.
File received and verified. Could not confirm delivery to the other device.
File verified and received in Qetara.
If you do not recognize any file or the verification does not match, reject the request.
If you do not recognize the file or the verification does not match, reject the request.
The request has ended. Ask the other device to try again.
Requesting a connection. Compare the verification on both devices.
Saved to Downloads / Qetara. Could not confirm delivery to the other device.
The selected device is no longer available. Search again or choose another.
The selected files are already prepared.
Selection empty. Choose files to share.
One of the files is no longer available or cannot be read. Check your selection.
Could not start. Check the other device and try again.
Flash has ended. Received files have been kept.
Flash’s time is up. Turn it on again whenever you need it.
Flash stays active when you return to Qetara. Received files are kept when you turn it off.
File preparation, requests and Flash transfers will stop. Received files will be kept.
Flash is off. Received files have been kept.
Waiting for a connection and confirmation on both devices.
